news.title: T.J. Hockenson (wrist) limited in practice Thursday

news.contents: Minnesota Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson (wrist) was listed as a limited participant in practice for the second straight day on Thursday. Hockenson did not play in Sunday's Week 10 win over the division-rival Green Bay Packers due to wrist and chest injuries, but he has ditched the chest designation and is on track to make his return in Mexico City on Sunday night in a showdown against the San Francisco 49ers. news.contents: George Pickens caught 7-of-10 targets for 102 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys 51-30 win over the Titans.
news.title: George Pickens catches touchdown Sunday

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens continued his strong 2026 season, recording seven catches on 10 targets for 102 yards (14.6 yards per reception) and a touchdown in a 51-30 win over the Tennessee Titans in Week 11. Pickens also recorded one rush for six yards. His touchdown came on a 10-yard pass from quarterback Dak Prescott in the second quarter, and Pickens' longest play of the day went for 31 yards.
